sources.snippet: AbbVie Inc., also known as AbbVie, is an American pharmaceutical company headquartered in North Chicago, Illinois. AbbVie produces drugs to treat a wide range of medical issues.
We partner with suppliers who share our commitment to creating medicines and solutions that put impact first.
